coordinated_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, getting dressed for university
Making and eating breakfast: toast, cereal and a cup of tea using the kettle and toaster
Packing backpack, checking the day's timetable and lecture notes on the phone
Commuting by public transport to Monash University Clayton campus
Attending Bachelor of Business lectures at Monash Clayton campus
Eating lunch and resting on campus between classes
Attending tutorials and working on a group business assignment in the campus library
Traveling from Clayton campus to Chadstone for the retail shift
Working a part-time retail shift at Chadstone: serving customers, restocking and tidying the shop floor
Commuting home from Chadstone by public transport
Heating and eating a late dinner using the microwave and refrigerator (avoiding the induction cooker during the peak period)
Showering and washing up after the shift
Reviewing lecture notes and checking emails on the computer with the desk lamp on
Setting an alarm, turning off the light and getting ready for bed
